scope: Real emulated multi-touch and rendered layouts with isolated simulation fixtures. Physical phone testing is separate.

checks.name: Touch controls detect a mobile browser
Start and commander choice fit the initial portrait viewport
First person works without Pointer Lock
Touch Jump performs a real jump
Swap changes the equipped attack after recovery
Field menu pauses and clears all combat intent
Mount is available without a keyboard
Held Rise flies and consumes mount energy
Weapons drawer owns pause after switching menus
Native attack can be selected in the inventory
Touch cancellation cannot stick movement or fire
One-finger strategy pan moves the view and stays finite
Pinch zoom changes distance without a tap or selection
